rules.name: Straight Combat
rules.description:
At the end of the game:
You score 1 Victory Point for every enemy unit destroyed.


If one player scores at least 2 more Victory Points than the other, then that side has won a clear victory. Otherwise, the result is deemed too close to call and honors are shared; a draw!

rules.name: Vehicular Warfare
rules.description:
At the end of the game:
You score 1 Victory Point for every enemy vehicle destroyed.


If one player scores at least 2 more Victory Points than the other, then that side has won a clear victory. Otherwise, the result is deemed too close to call and honors are shared; a draw!

characteristics.name: Lore
characteristics.$text: As opposing forces meet one another, their vehicles come forth into the fray with the clear intention of wiping each other out, armored columns breaking out and fighting until their last; whoever has armored superiority will win this day.

rules.name: Command Removal(Simple)
rules.description:
At the end of the game:
You score 1 Victory Point for every enemy HEADQUARTERS unit destroyed.
You score 1 Victory Point for every 2 Enemy non-HEADQUARTERS Units destroyed.


If one player scores at least 1 more Victory Points than the other, then that side has won a clear victory. Otherwise, the result is deemed too close to call and honors are shared; a draw!

characteristics.name: Lore
characteristics.$text: Almost every force is lead by a leader, or group of leaders that command their troops towards war. Remove the leadership and end a battle before it begins!

rules.name: All-Out Warfare(Advanced)
rules.description:
At the end of the game:
Each enemy CORE Unit killed: +1 victory point
Each enemy ELITE Unit killed: +1 victory point
Each enemy VEHICLE destroyed:+2 victory point
Each enemy SPECIALIST Unit killed: +2 victory point
Each enemy Headquarters Unit killed: +2 victory point 


If one player scores at least 3 more Victory Points than the other, then that side has won a clear victory. Otherwise, the result is deemed too close to call and honors are shared; a draw!

rules.name: Toppling Towers
rules.description:
Recommended to add a game round limit.


Attackers:
For every Light Defense Tower that was destroyed:+1 Victory Points,.
If all Light Defense Towers were destroyed, Score 5 Victory Points instead.
(If using Round Limit): If you have more than half of your army's units within the Defender's Deployment Zone:+3 Victory Points

Defenders:
For Every Light Defense Tower that has not been destroyed:+1 Victory Point.
If all Light Defense Towers have not been destroyed, Score 5 Victory Points instead.
For Every Light Defense Tower that has a friendly unit within it: +1 Victory Point.
(If using Round Limit): If you have more than half of your army's units within your Deployment Zone:+3 Victory Points.


If one player scores at least 2 more Victory Points than the other, then that side has won a clear victory. Otherwise, the result is deemed too close to call and honors are shared; a draw!

rules.name: Objective Preparation
rules.description:
Deployment: As you roll off to see who deploys first, whoever goes first can choose between Attacker and Defender. Defenders will always deploy their entire force first, Attackers will deploy second and as normal.


Terrain: Set up 3 Light Defense Towers Fortifications in the Defender's Deployment zone. These can be placed anywhere but must be 6 inches or more away from any table edge, must be 6 inches or more away from any other Terrain Features and cannot be outside the deployment zone.

rules.name: Scrap for Parts
rules.description:
Any friendly INFANTRY Unit within 3 inches of a destroyed vehicle may use an action to "Scrap it for Parts!"


Scrap it for Parts!: The unit performing this action does an Intelligence Test. If they succeed, mark that vehicle as scrapped and cannot be targeted again for "Scrap it for Parts!".


At the end of the game, for every scrapped vehicle, earn 1 victory point.

rules.name: Flawless Assault
rules.description:
At the end of the game, if the amount of friendly units that have died is LESS or equal than half of all enemy units that were killed, earn 1 victory point; and an additional one if there is a differential that is one more than required.


Example: if the enemy lost 6 enemy units, you lost 3, you would gain 1 victory point. However if you only lost 2 units, you would gain 2 victory points; 1 from initial scoring and another 1 from having one less than required.

characteristics.name: Lore
characteristics.$text: This force-albeit pride or skill- has great belief they will not lose this day

rules.name: Assassinate Target
rules.description: During Deployment, select one Headquarters Unit from your opponent's army to be your target. At the end of the game, if that unit was killed, earn 1 Victory Point, if it was their Army Commander, earn 2 Victory Points. If you did not kill that unit, lose 1 Victory Point, if it was their Army Commander; lose 2 Instead.

characteristics.name: Lore
characteristics.$text: Your force has been charged with killing an enemy leader, with even whispers of them being the very leader of the entire enemy force! However, if you fail, grave consequences could occur...

rules.name: Witch Hunt
rules.description:
Kill the Enemy Psyker or Mage with the highest Level. If you cannot kill him, wound them instead. 
Most powerful Enemy Psyker/Mage wounded: 1 Victory Point.
Most Powerful Enemy Psyker/Mage killed: 3 Victory Points.
If the Most Powerful Enemy Psyker/Mage was killed by a friendly Psyker/Mage: 5 Victory Points.

characteristics.name: Lore
characteristics.$text: A powerful user of arcane texts or the uncontained power of one's mind has been spotted. It is imperative to seek out and destroy this dangerous source of unimaginable power.

rules.name: Total Amount of Misc.
rules.description: Total Amount of Primary Objectives Agreed upon. This is the same for both players.

rules.name: Total Amount of Misc.
rules.description: Total Amount of Misc. Objectives Agreed upon.

rules.name: Total Amount of Misc.
rules.description: Total Amount of Primary Objectives Agreed upon. Players can have different Secondary Objectives; unless a scenario calls otherwise.
